entries.24919fe2ab972e97: This category mainly consists of shipping fee revenue, service revenue, licensing income and others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥545 million.
entries.25ceb507e44df16b: This category covers the “Hobonichi Techo” and related stationery (covers, desk sheets, stickers, etc.). It also offers collaboration products with popular characters and artists. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥5,850 million, of which ¥2,777 million was in Japan and ¥3,072 million overseas. Sales volume for the 2025 edition was 960,000 copies.
entries.32019ddcb146730e: This category covers products other than the “Hobonichi Techo.” They are sold through the company's own EC site, “Hobonichi Online Store,” and also at retail events such as “Seikatsu no Tanoshimi-ten.” Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥2,282 million.
entries.40a3b91ed69f9004: Web Media and Product Sales Business
entries.6e0d54e012732691: A company that creates "places" such as the website "Hobonichi," and plans, produces, and sells products and content, including the "Hobonichi Techo."
entries.c8b71e20201dda6a: This single-segment business combines web media, such as the website “Hobonichi,” with sales of products led by the “Hobonichi Techo.” It creates a “place” where content creators and audiences meet, delivering content such as readings and videos along with products such as planners and miscellaneous goods. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥8,677 million. Its main locations are the store TOBICHI in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, which also serves as its head office; TOBICHI Kyoto in Kyoto, Kyoto Prefecture; the event space Hobonichi Nichiyobi in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo; and the studio of Hobonichi no Gakkō in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo.
entries.d16a484fd4817bf1: Individual customers who use websites, EC sites and physical stores
